item.title: Lutsen Lodge owner charged with arson in 2024 fire
item.description: LUTSEN, Minn. (KVRR/FOX 21) — The owner of Lutsen Lodge has been charged with arson in connection with the 2024 fire. item.title: Minnesota’s budget and economic forecast shows current surplus with a looming deficit
item.description: ST. PAUL, Minn. (KVRR/KFGO) — Minnesota’s budget and economic outlook remains stable in the current biennium.
